## LG-SOTF response actions
Receives the signed POST that LG-SOTF sends for each approved action (schema `lg-sotf.response-action.v1`).

1. Store the tenant's webhook secret as the n8n variable `LGSOTF_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (or environment variable, with `N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false`). Never paste it into a node.
2. Self-hosted: set `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto` (on the task runners too).
3. For each action type you handle: configure the **TODO** node (URL, credential, body), then enable it. Disabled nodes answer `rejected` / `not_implemented`.
4. Activate the workflow and set the production URL as the tenant's webhook URL in LG-SOTF.

Rollbacks arrive as their own action types (`release_host`, `unblock_ip`, ...) with `rollback_of` set to the id of the action to undo.

The vendor calls in the node notes are examples: verify them against your vendor's API documentation. See docs/soar-playbooks.md.

nodes.name: Read me
LG-SOTF webhook
Verify LG-SOTF signature
nodes.notes: HMAC-SHA256 over '<timestamp>.<raw body>', 5-minute window, Idempotency-Key = action.id, dedup on action.id.

nodes.name: Authentic and new?
Route by action type
TODO block_ip: firewall or EDR indicator
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Defender for Endpoint POST /api/indicators (IpAddress, Block); PAN-OS dynamic address group tag; Cloudflare IP access rule.

nodes.name: TODO block_domain: DNS or proxy block list
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Defender for Endpoint indicator (DomainName, Block); Cisco Umbrella destination list.

nodes.name: TODO block_url: web proxy block list
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Defender for Endpoint indicator (Url, Block); Zscaler ZIA custom URL category, then activate.

nodes.name: TODO isolate_host: EDR network isolation
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Resolve the host to exactly one device first. Defender for Endpoint POST /api/machines/{id}/isolate; CrowdStrike devices-actions contain.

nodes.name: TODO terminate_process: EDR kill on the scoped hosts
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Only on params.scope.hosts; empty scope = do nothing. CrowdStrike Real Time Response kill.

nodes.name: TODO quarantine_file: EDR quarantine by hash
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Defender for Endpoint POST /api/machines/{id}/StopAndQuarantineFile (SHA-1) per scoped host.

nodes.name: TODO disable_user: disable the account in the identity provider
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Microsoft Graph PATCH /v1.0/users/{id} {accountEnabled:false}; Okta lifecycle/suspend.

nodes.name: TODO reset_password: force a password reset in the identity provider
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Okta lifecycle/expire_password; AD Set-ADUser -ChangePasswordAtLogon via a runner.

nodes.name: TODO revoke_sessions: revoke sessions in the identity provider
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Microsoft Graph POST /v1.0/users/{id}/revokeSignInSessions; Okta DELETE /api/v1/users/{id}/sessions.

nodes.name: TODO collect_forensics: EDR evidence collection
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Defender for Endpoint POST /api/machines/{id}/collectInvestigationPackage; return the job id.

nodes.name: TODO create_ticket: ticketing system
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Only sent when the tenant has no ticketing integration in LG-SOTF. Jira POST /rest/api/3/issue; ServiceNow POST /api/now/table/incident.

nodes.name: TODO send_alert: SOC chat or paging
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Slack chat.postMessage; PagerDuty Events API v2 /v2/enqueue.

nodes.name: TODO block_sender: mail gateway sender block list
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Microsoft 365: no Graph API; New-TenantAllowBlockListItems -ListType Sender -Block (Exchange Online PowerShell) from a runner.

nodes.name: TODO purge_message: mailbox purge (Message-ID, sender and subject)
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Match Message-ID AND sender AND subject. Microsoft Graph per mailbox: messages?$filter=internetMessageId eq '...' then move or delete.

nodes.name: TODO notify_reporter: email the reporter
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Microsoft Graph POST /v1.0/users/{mailbox}/sendMail from a restricted shared mailbox.

nodes.name: TODO confirm_compromised: mark the account compromised in the risk engine
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Microsoft Graph POST /v1.0/identityProtection/riskyUsers/confirmCompromised {userIds:[id]} (Entra ID P2).

nodes.name: TODO release_host: lift EDR network isolation (rollback)
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Defender for Endpoint POST /api/machines/{id}/unisolate; CrowdStrike devices-actions lift_containment.

nodes.name: TODO unblock_ip: remove the IP block (rollback)
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Delete the rule or indicator created for rollback_of: Defender for Endpoint DELETE /api/indicators/{id}.

nodes.name: TODO unblock_domain: remove the DNS or proxy block (rollback)
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Defender for Endpoint DELETE /api/indicators/{id}; Cisco Umbrella destination list remove.

nodes.name: TODO unblock_url: remove the web proxy block (rollback)
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Defender for Endpoint DELETE /api/indicators/{id}; Zscaler ZIA REMOVE_FROM_LIST, then activate.

nodes.name: TODO unblock_file: remove the hash block (rollback)
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Defender for Endpoint DELETE /api/indicators/{id} of the file indicator created for rollback_of.

nodes.name: TODO unblock_sender: remove the sender block (rollback)
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Microsoft 365: Remove-TenantAllowBlockListItems -ListType Sender (Exchange Online PowerShell) from a runner.

nodes.name: TODO enable_user: re-enable the account (rollback)
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Microsoft Graph PATCH /v1.0/users/{id} {accountEnabled:true}; Okta lifecycle/unsuspend.

nodes.name: TODO restore_message: restore the purged messages (rollback)
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Move back exactly the items the purge of rollback_of removed: Microsoft Graph POST /v1.0/users/{id}/messages/{item}/move to the original folder.

nodes.name: TODO dismiss_user_risk: dismiss the account risk (rollback)
nodes.notes: Example to verify: Microsoft Graph POST /v1.0/identityProtection/riskyUsers/dismiss {userIds:[id]}.

nodes.name: Unsupported action type
nodes.notes: Action types without a branch are answered rejected (never silently succeeded).

nodes.name: Build LG-SOTF result
nodes.notes: 2xx from the vendor = succeeded, anything else = failed; remembered for 7 days for deduplication.
